Coupled Technique(s).cell: SEM (Carl Zeiss 1550VP FE-SEM, BSE imaging); EBSD; synchrotron XRD; micro-Raman
Coupled Technique(s).value: SEM (Carl Zeiss 1550VP FE-SEM, BSE imaging); EBSD; synchrotron XRD; micro-Raman

Target Material.cell: liebermannite; lingunite; maskelynite — Table 1: 'Analytical data for liebermannite and associated lingunite and maskelynite'

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Polished thin section USNM 7619 (coating type N)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Polished thin section USNM 7619 (coating type N)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain > Analysis point — Table 1 reports one column per occurrence ("Type liebermannite", "The second liebermannite", "The third liebermannite", "Lingunite next to type liebermannite" …), each the mean of n = 2–6 points (p.3)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Occurrence of the target phase — the units analysed are the observed occurrences of the new mineral: "A first occurrence of liebermannite was observed with lingunite, silica, ilmenite, and baddeleyite ... (this is the type material). A second occurrence ... A third occurrence is shown in Fig. 1c, close to the type occurrence" (p.4)

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM BSE imaging on a ZEISS 1550VP field-emission SEM — "Backscattered electron (BSE) imaging was performed using a Carl Zeiss, LLC 1550VP field emission SEM" (p.2), locating the three occurrences of the new mineral in the Zagami thin section (Fig. 1, p.2). The paper lists EPMA, SEM, EBSD, synchrotron XRD and micro-Raman as one suite (p.2) without stating the order
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM BSE imaging on a ZEISS 1550VP field-emission SEM

Instrument Model.cell: JEOL 8200 (stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe"; no JXA prefix in paper)
Instrument Model.value: JEOL 8200 (stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe"; no JXA prefix in paper)

Data Processing Software(s).cell: N — the 'CITZAF correction procedure' is recorded under Matrix Correction Method; the only software named is Probe for EPMA

Analytical Mode.cell: WDS Point Analysis — 'WDS: 15 kV, 5 nA'; the paper also mentions 'K-mapping by EPMA', with no detector or conditions

Beam Mode.cell: all: Focused — 'WDS: 15 kV, 5 nA, beam in focused mode' (p.2)

Beam Diameter.cell: N — 'beam in focused mode' is recorded under Beam Mode; no diameter is given

Beam Damage Minimization.cell: all: low beam current (5 nA) — 'Although a low beam current of 5 nA was used for the analysis, the low cation sum (0.92) for the K-site is likely due to diffusion of Na away from the electron beam' (p.3)

Target Species.cell: Si, Al, K, Na, Ca, Fe, Mg, Ti, Cr, Mn (stated via standards sentence and detection limit list)

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: Si, Al, K, Ca, Na, Fe, Mg, Ti, Cr, Mn — all determined. "Standards for analysis were Asbestos microcline (SiKa, AlKa, KKa), synthetic anorthite (CaKa), Amelia albite (NaKa), synthetic fayalite (FeKa), synthetic forsterite (MgKa), synthetic TiO2 (TiKa), synthetic Cr2O3 (CrKa), and synthetic Mn-olivine (MnKa)", with detection limits quoted for the same ten (p.2)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, FeO, CaO, Na2O, K2O; cations per formula unit; density — oxide wt% with totals and 1 s.d. of the mean, cations on 8 oxygens (Table 1); 'Magnesium, Cr, and Mn were also analyzed but were below the detection limit in all cases'; calculated density 3.98 g cm-3 (p.3)

X-ray Line.cell: Si, Al, K, Ca, Na, Fe, Mg, Ti, Cr, Mn: Ka — 'Asbestos microcline (SiKa, AlKa, KKa), synthetic anorthite (CaKa), Amelia albite (NaKa), synthetic fayalite (FeKa), synthetic forsterite (MgKa), synthetic TiO2 (TiKa), synthetic Cr2O3 (CrKa), and synthetic Mn-olivine (MnKa)'

Peak Counting Time.cell: all: 20 s — 'Counting times were 20 s on-peak and 10 s each on high and low background positions' (p.2)

Background Counting Time.cell: all: 10 s on each of the high and low background positions — as above

value.value: 10 s on each of the high and low background positions

Background Position(s).cell: all: high and low — 'high and low background positions'; offsets not given

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — each Table 1 column is the mean of n point analyses of one occurrence (n = 6, 2, 3, 3, 5 and 4; p.3), with one standard deviation of the mean. No acceptance or rejection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, FeO, CaO, Na2O, K2O: mean of n point analyses per occurrence; other: N — Table 1 notes b and c

value.value: mean of n point analyses per occurrence

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Si, Al, K: Asbestos microcline; Ca: synthetic anorthite; Na: Amelia albite; Fe: synthetic fayalite; Mg: synthetic forsterite; Ti: synthetic TiO2; Cr: synthetic Cr2O3; Mn: synthetic Mn-olivine] — p.2

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: feldspar standards — 'based on analysis of feldspar standards as unknowns'; not named individually

Detection Limit.cell: Si: 0.05 wt%; Ti: 0.04 wt%; Al: 0.06 wt%; Fe: 0.06 wt%; Mg: 0.02 wt%; Ca: 0.02 wt%; Na: 0.03 wt%; K: 0.02 wt%; Cr: 0.05 wt%; Mn: 0.06 wt% — 'The detection limits (wt%) are 0.05 Si, 0.04 Ti, ...' (p.2) — stated per element, while Table 1 reports oxides

Analytical Accuracy.cell: feldspar standards [Si, Al, Ca, Na, K: 1–2%; other: N] — 'The accuracy is 1–2% for Si, Al, Ca, Na, and K, based on analysis of feldspar standards as unknowns' — per element, while Table 1 reports oxides

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Ma et al. 2018, Meteorit. Planet. Sci. 53:50-61 (file dated 2017) — liebermannite (KAlSi3O8) discovery from Zagami. Instrument stated as "JEOL 8200 electron microprobe" (no JXA prefix in text). WDS explicitly stated ("WDS: 15 kV, 5 nA"). Probe for EPMA; CITZAF correction (Armstrong 1995) — NOT PAP. Full standard suite and X-ray lines stated. K-mapping by EPMA also performed (used for mineral identification) but mapping conditions (step size, dwell time, current) not stated. Na diffusion observed during analysis despite low 5 nA beam current. Detection limits stated (per-element wt% values). Analytical accuracy: 1-2% for Si, Al, Ca, Na, K (feldspar standards as unknowns). Caltech GPS Division Analytical Facility.
Additional Notes.value: Ma et al. 2018, Meteorit. Planet. Sci. 53:50-61 (file dated 2017)
